_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Honduras covering Copán Maya kingdom (UNESCO, greatest Maya art), Lenca/Pech indigenous peoples, Lempira resistance, Columbus 1502 (named for 'depths' of Caribbean), colonial silver mining, Comayagua/Tegucigalpa rivalry, independence 1821, federal Central America, banana republic era (United Fruit Company coined 'banana republic'), Football War 1969 vs El Salvador, Hurricane Mitch 1998 (9,000+ dead), 2009 coup (Zelaya), gang violence (MS-13, world's highest murder rate), and Juan Orlando Hernández (drug trafficking conviction).

religion.note: Evangelicalization accelerating (almost parity with Catholicism); Pentecostal churches especially strong in gang-affected communities; Garífuna spiritual practices (dugu); Suyapa Virgin patron

ethnic_groups.name: Mestizo
ethnic_groups.notes: Mixed Indigenous-European; dominant identity; Spanish-speaking; culturally homogeneous mainla

ethnic_groups.name: Indigenous
ethnic_groups.notes: Lenca (largest, descendants of Lempira), Miskito (Mosquito Coast, semi-autonomous history, Afro-Indigenous), Pech, Tol, Chorti Maya, Nahua; Lempira (national hero, resisted Spanish); marginalized

ethnic_groups.name: Garífuna
ethnic_groups.notes: Afro-Caribbean-Arawak; north coast (Tela, La Ceiba, Trujillo); arrived 1797 from St. Vincent; UNESCO intangible heritage; Punta music/dance; culturally vibrant

ethnic_groups.name: Black/White/Other
ethnic_groups.notes: Bay Islands English-speaking Black community (British/African heritage); white Hondurans (small elite); Arab descent ('turcos', Palestinian/Lebanese, economically powerful)

country_profile.notes_unique: Copán (UNESCO, greatest Classic Maya sculpture/hieroglyphic stairway); 'Banana Republic' term coined for Honduras (O. Henry, United Fruit/Cuyamel dominance, Sam Zemurray); Hurricane Mitch 1998 (deadliest Atlantic hurricane in 200 years for Honduras, 9,000+ dead, set development back 20 years); 2009 coup against Zelaya (first Latin American coup in 21st century); world's highest murder rate (2011-12, San Pedro Sula); MS-13/Barrio 18 gangs; JOH (Juan Orlando Hernández, president convicted of drug trafficking in US, 45-year sentence); migration caravans; Football War 1969 (vs El Salvador, 4 days)

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.

current_leader.name: Xiomara Castro
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: LIBRE party; first female president; wife of deposed Zelaya; left-wing; anti-corruption; ended Taiwan recognition; CICIH (UN anti-corruption) talks

former_leaders.name: Juan Orlando Hernández (JOH)
former_leaders.notes: National Party; re-elected 2017 (disputed); extradited to US 2022; convicted of drug trafficking (conspired with cartels, used Honduran military); 45-year sentence; narco-state allegations

former_leaders.name: Porfirio Lobo Sosa
former_leaders.notes: National Party; elected post-coup; son convicted of drug trafficking; corruption

former_leaders.name: Roberto Micheletti
former_leaders.notes: De facto president after Zelaya coup; not internationally recognized; Liberal Party; interim

former_leaders.name: Manuel Zelaya
former_leaders.notes: Liberal turned left; aligned with Chavez/ALBA; removed in military coup June 28, 2009 (constitution dispute); exiled; returned; wife Xiomara now president

former_leaders.name: Carlos Roberto Reina
former_leaders.notes: Liberal; 'moral revolution'; ended mandatory military service; judicial reform

former_leaders.name: Tiburcio Carías Andino
former_leaders.notes: National Party; longest-serving ruler; caudillo; United Fruit ally; Honduran Trujillo equivalent; extended term multiple times; repressed opposition
